name: WF-458 — Seller Response → AI Intent, Motivation Update & Negotiation/Offer Routing Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const portfolioId=String(b.portfolioId??'').trim(); const responseId=String(b.responseId??b.messageId??'').trim(); const responseText=String(b.responseText??b.message??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,portfolioId,responseId,responseText,dealId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Seller Response').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const text=input.responseText.toLowerCase(); const dnc=ctx.dnc===true||ctx.suppressed===true; const closed=ctx.closed===true||['closed','cancelled','lost'].includes(String(ctx.leadStatus??'').toLowerCase()); const replyDuplicate=ctx.responseAlreadyProcessed===true; const intentRules=[['dnc',/(do not contact|stop contacting|remove me|unsubscribe|don't text|dont text)/],['accepted',/(yes|accept|accepted|sounds good|deal|let's do it|lets do it)/],['counteroffer',/(counter|i can do|would take|take \$|for \$|price is)/],['offer_question',/(offer|how much|what can you pay|your price|cash offer)/],['call_request',/(call me|give me a call|phone call|talk on the phone)/],['not_interested',/(not interested|no thanks|pass|no deal)/],['nurture',/(later|next month|next year|not ready|maybe later)/]]; let intent='other'; for(const [k,r] of intentRules){if(r.test(text)){intent=k;break;}} const sentiment=/ (hate|angry|mad|terrible|scam) /.test(text)?'negative':/ (good|great|thanks|interested|yes) /.test(text)?'positive':'neutral'; let motivationDelta=0; if(/urgent|asap|quick|soon|need to sell/.test(text))motivationDelta+=15; if(/divorce|inherit|inherited|foreclosure|tax|vacant|repairs|tenant|relocat/.test(text))motivationDelta+=10; if(/later|not ready/.test(text))motivationDelta-=10; const baseMotivation=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(ctx.motivationScore??50))); const updatedMotivation=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,baseMotivation+motivationDelta)); let route='manual_review'; let nextAction='review_response'; if(dnc||intent==='dnc'){route='do_not_contact';nextAction='suppress_future_outreach';} else if(closed){route='closed_lead';nextAction='no_further_pipeline_advance';} else if(replyDuplicate){route='duplicate_response';nextAction='do_not_reprocess';} else if(intent==='accepted'){route='contract_and_deal_advancement';nextAction='verify_contract_readiness_and_proceed';} else if(intent==='counteroffer'){route='negotiation_and_offer_evaluation';nextAction='evaluate_counteroffer_against_protected_mao';} else if(intent==='offer_question'){route='offer_follow_up';nextAction='prepare_or_explain_offer_without_exposing_protected_mao';} else if(intent==='call_request'){route='appointment_or_call_follow_up';nextAction='offer_or_schedule_call';} else if(intent==='not_interested'){route='closed_lost_or_nurture';nextAction='determine_nurture_eligibility';} else if(intent==='nurture'){route='nurture_sequence';nextAction='schedule_reengagement';} else if(intent==='other'){route='human_review';nextAction='review_unclassified_response';} const priority=updatedMotivation>=80?'A':updatedMotivation>=60?'B':updatedMotivation>=40?'C':'D'; const flags=[]; if(sentiment==='negative')flags.push('negative_sentiment'); if(intent==='counteroffer')flags.push('counteroffer_detected'); if(intent==='accepted')flags.push('seller_acceptance_signal'); if(dnc)flags.push('existing_dnc_or_suppression'); const idempotencyKey='wf458:'+input.leadId+':'+input.responseId; return [{json:{...input,sellerResponseRouting:{intent,sentiment,motivationScoreBefore:baseMotivation,motivationDelta,updatedMotivation,priorityTier:priority,route,nextAction,flags,duplicate:replyDuplicate,requiresHumanReview:route==='human_review'||sentiment==='negative',confidenceScore:intent==='other'?45:90},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Classifies inbound seller responses, updates motivation/priority, protects DNC and closed states, and routes accepted, counteroffer, offer-question, call-request, rejection and nurture signals. Production use requires verified NLP/AI evaluation, response schema, canonical protected-MAO source, communication controls and production InsulaCRM API contracts.
